documentTypes.label: General Clinical Letter
documentTypes.description: A flexible clinical letter for general psychiatric documentation needs.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Draft a concise, professional Astra-formatted clinical letter using only supported information from the uploaded note, raw app output, and provider description.

documentTypes.label: Emotional Support Animal Letter
documentTypes.description: A letter supporting an emotional support animal request when clinically appropriate.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Draft only if the clinical source supports the need. Avoid unsupported legal conclusions and use bracketed placeholders for missing disability, animal, or housing details.

documentTypes.label: Work Accommodation Letter
documentTypes.description: A workplace accommodation letter tied to supported symptoms or limitations.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Describe clinically supported limitations and requested accommodations without exaggerating impairment or making unsupported employment/legal conclusions.

documentTypes.label: School Accommodation Letter
documentTypes.description: A school or testing accommodation letter.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Connect requested accommodations to supported psychiatric symptoms, diagnosis, or history. Flag missing school, program, testing, or accommodation details.

documentTypes.label: Medication Confirmation Letter
documentTypes.description: A letter confirming medication treatment when supported by the record.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Confirm only medications clearly supported by uploaded/current materials. Flag uncertain dose, frequency, start date, adherence, or indication details.

documentTypes.label: Treatment Participation Letter
documentTypes.description: A letter confirming participation in psychiatric treatment.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Confirm treatment participation, dates, frequency, and provider relationship only when clearly supported. Avoid disclosure beyond what is necessary.

documentTypes.label: Diagnostic Clarification Letter
documentTypes.description: A letter clarifying psychiatric diagnoses and relevant clinical context.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Use careful diagnostic language. Do not add diagnoses or certainty not supported by the note. Flag provisional or conflicting diagnosis information.

documentTypes.label: Fitness / Clearance Letter
documentTypes.description: A limited fitness or clearance letter when supported by clinical information.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Avoid broad clearance claims unless directly supported. State limitations, scope, and need for provider review clearly.

documentTypes.label: Return to Work / School Letter
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Draft return language only within the supported clinical scope, including any restrictions or phased return details provided by the clinician.

documentTypes.label: Care Coordination Letter
documentTypes.description: A letter for coordination with another clinician, school, employer, or agency.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Summarize only relevant information needed for coordination. Keep tone collaborative and concise, and avoid unnecessary PHI.

documentTypes.label: Insurance / Prior Authorization Support Letter
documentTypes.description: A support letter for insurance or prior authorization needs.
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Use documented treatment history, medical necessity, medication trials, response, and adverse effects only when supported. Flag missing insurer or medication details.

documentTypes.label: Patient Status Update Letter
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Provide a concise, clinically appropriate update using only supported current status, treatment plan, and relevant history.

documentTypes.label: Custom Letter
documentTypes.gptGuidance: Follow the clinician's description closely while applying Astra tone, provider verification, and no-invented-facts rules.
